quarterly_data.signal: Marvell's 10-K: total unconditional purchase commitments to foundries and test and assembly partners were $2,665.8 million, of which $1,871.8 million falls in fiscal 2027, and commitments for capital expenditures were approximately $152.0 million as of January 31, 2026. Under manufacturing supply capacity reservation agreements with foundries and test and assembly suppliers (terms of 4 to 10 years), Marvell estimates purchase level commitments of at least $458.2 million of wafers, substrates and other manufacturing products for fiscal 2027 through fiscal 2033 (included in the purchase commitments table), plus $23.1 million of capacity fees and refundable deposits payable in fiscal 2027 through fiscal 2028. Prepayments on supply capacity reservation agreements were $278.8 million in the balance-sheet column labelled 2026 versus $307.8 million in the column labelled 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: purchase commitments to foundries and test/assembly partners $2,665.8 million ($1,871.8 million in fiscal 2027); capacity reservation purchase commitments at least $458.2 million (fiscal 2027-2033) + $23.1 million fees/deposits (fiscal 2027-2028); capacity reservation prepayments $278.8 million (2026 column) vs $307.8 million (2025 column); capex commitments ~$152.0 million (January 31, 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: In connection with the Celestial AI acquisition, Marvell on December 2, 2025 entered into a warrant and related transaction agreement to issue to an affiliate of an unnamed customer a warrant for up to 1.0 million shares of Marvell common stock, which vest based on Marvell revenue through December 31, 2030 from that customer's direct or indirect purchases of Marvell's photonic fabric products.
quarterly_data.figure: warrant for up to 1.0 million shares vesting on the customer's photonic fabric purchases through December 31, 2030
